title: The menu's version line
objective: The menu's first item names the build as the sibling menubar apps do: menuz <version> (<commit>), dirty- before the commit of a dirty source and dev after the parentheses unless the build is a release, read from the bundle's stamps (D14); the shim stamps MENUZ_KIND and the eight-character MENUZ_COMMIT, --render prints the row first, and the help and the CHANGELOG say so.
